scripts.speaker: Spectator
scripts.text:
If you tell me to not go in, isn't it going to make me want to go inside even more? But it doesn't look like there's anything interesting to see.
I see no monsters here...

scripts.speaker: Passerby
scripts.text: No... I'm just passing by. I don't want to go inside...

scripts.speaker: Traveler
scripts.text: Rumors have been spreading that there are monsters living here. People claim to hear the ground rumbling because of them...

scripts.speaker: Traveler
scripts.text: I want to go explore inside...

scripts.speaker: Adventurer
scripts.text: Do you think there's going to be treasure inside this place?

scripts.speaker: Adventurer
scripts.text: It kind of smells like it...
